name: Lokesh Kumar Verma
summary:
• Dynamic business leader with around 25 years of experience in market development, business expansion, and value
chain scaling across national markets.
• Proven track record in driving revenue growth, leading sales & marketing strategies, and building strong, long-term
client relationships.
• Expert in retail model design, corporate decision-making, and optimizing operations to boost top and bottom-line
performance.
• Skilled at market Intelligence, competitor benchmarking, and launching high-impact go-to-market strategies.
• Recognized as a sales accelerator with entrepreneurial zeal and a relentless drive to win in fast-paced, competitive
markets.
• Visionary leader with sharp analytical abilities and a strong focus on team building, strategy execution, and sustainable
growth.
